name: rhythm-desktop
description: A personal music library and player
author: Rhythm contributors

scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node scripts/startup.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/features.mjs && node scripts/interchange.mjs && node scripts/acceptance.mjs && node scripts/managed.mjs && node scripts/recovery.mjs && node scripts/track-info.mjs && node scripts/playback-recovery.mjs && node scripts/removal.mjs && node scripts/albums.mjs
scripts.test:packaged: node scripts/smoke.mjs --packaged && node scripts/features.mjs --packaged && node scripts/interchange.mjs --packaged && node scripts/acceptance.mjs --packaged && node scripts/managed.mjs --packaged && node scripts/recovery.mjs --packaged && node scripts/track-info.mjs --packaged && node scripts/playback-recovery.mjs --packaged && node scripts/removal.mjs --packaged && node scripts/albums.mjs --packaged
scripts.pack: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json .github/workflows/build.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json package.json .github/workflows/build.yml
